sources.quote: Alpha Cassiopeiae is a star in the northern constellation of Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 734 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,690 K, so 41.078 solar radii.

sources.quote: Though listed as the "alpha star" by Johann Bayer, α Cas's visual brightness closely matches the 'beta' (β) star in the constellation and it may appear marginally brighter or dimmer, depending on which passband is used.
